notes.title: Shot Online Steam Service Closure Events
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/631df54ed41687e983703ba5e9326143a30f83d8.jpg[/img]

Dear Shot Online Community, 

Although Shot Online Steam will be ending services, we are preparing events so users can enjoy playing until the last minute! After concluding our ongoing July events, starting on August 1st we will be holding several in-game events. Also, on July 24th, with closure of in-game CC purchase, we will be starting sales events as well!


[b][h1]1. 100CC Shop Open[/h1][/b]
Starting on July 25th 10AM (UTC), we will be starting an in-game 100CC shop! Through this, you will be able to buy various items at a price of 100CC. 


[b][h1]2. New items for the Item Recipe System[/h1][/b]
Along with the start of the 100CC shop, we will also be adding new items to the Item Recipe System. The 50% rune discount will be applied to the newly added items as well!


[b][h1]3. Mini Game Event[/h1][/b]
One of our in-game events will be the Mini Game Event! The procedure is the same as the previous Mini Game events. The time period for the Mini Game events are as follows:
[table]
     [tr]
         [th][b]Duration[/b][/th]
         [th][b]Putting[/b][/th]
         [th][b]Nearest[/b][/th]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]August[/td]
         [td]Aug 6th 00:00 ~ Aug 17th 23:59 (UTC)[/td]
         [td]Aug 20th 00:00 ~ Aug 31th 23:59 (UTC)[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]September[/td]
         [td]Sep 2nd 00:00 ~ Sep 13th 23:59 (UTC)[/td]
         [td]Sep 16th 00:00 ~ Sep 27th 23:59 (UTC)[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]October[/td]
         [td]Oct 7th 00:00 ~ Oct 18th 23:59 (UTC)[/td]
         [td]Oct 21st 00:00 ~ Nov 1st 23:59 (UTC)[/td]
     [/tr]
[/table] 

Below are the details of the events.
[b]A.	Putting Mini Game[/b]

[b]Daily Join Limit[/b]: 10

Stage 1 Reward: Cyma I
Stage 2 Reward: Zodiac Drei 100
Stage 3 Reward: Baxter’s Lucky Token [1h]
Stage 4 Reward: Zodiac Plus 100
Stage 5 Reward: Swing trainer K-2 [20%]
Stage 6 Reward: Odin I Brooch [10%/10%]
Stage 7 Reward: Bianca’s Lucky Token [1h]
Stage 8 Reward: Theurgia P40 18
Stage 9 Reward: Mageia Plus N4 18
Stage 10 Reward: Menoetios Ball 4PC [40%] 18
	
[b]Special Rewards:[/b]
10 Flags: EXP box 1%
20 Flags: EXP box 2%
30 Flags: EXP box 3%

[h1]- You must receive the rewards within 24 hours after the event is over[/h1]

[b]B.	Nearest Mini Game[/b]

[b]Daily Join Limit[/b]: 10

[b]Daily Join Reward[/b]: One Point Lesson Ticket 200
[b]1st Place[/b]: Ambrosia 45% 10
[b]2nd Place[/b]: Ambrosia 40% 10
[b]3rd Place[/b]: Ambrosia 35% 10
4th~20th Place: Ambrosia 30% 10

[h1]- Daily Join Reward will be distributed as soon as you join the Mini game event.
- Ranking Rewards will be distributed once you re-connect to the game after the event concludes.[/h1]
- For more information and details, please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1655883053] Mini Game Guide[/url] page.


[b][h1]4. Daily Holecount Event[/h1][/b]
The Holecount Event will also begin starting on August 1st. The Holecount Event will take place [b]every Mondays through Fridays[/b]! The rewards and details regarding the event are as follows:
[table]
     [tr]
         [th]Course[/th]
         [th]Mode[/th]
         [th]Requirement[/th]
         [th]Reward[/th]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]All courses[/td]
         [td]All modes[/td]
         [td]7 Birdies or better[/td]
         [td]One Point Lesson Ticket 500[/td]
     [/tr]
[/table] 
Holecount events will reset at midnight daily.


[b][h1]5. Mission Event[/h1][/b]
The third event will be the Mission Event. From August 1st to November 6th, you will be able to encounter Mission Events through rounding. Mission events will be held only on Weekends! Details regarding the event are as follows:
[table]
     [tr]
         [th]Course[/th]
         [th]Mode[/th]
         [th]Requirement[/th]
         [th]Reward[/th]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]All courses (except CT Park Public)[/td]
         [td]Stroke, Swift Stroke[/td]
         [td]Achieve a Birdie or better on each hole[/td]
         [td]Special Drop Box[/td]
     [/tr]
[/table] 


[b][h1]6. EXP Buff Event[/h1][/b]
From August 1st to November 6th, there will be a 30% Bonus EXP buff for all players on server. The 30% Bonus EXP buff will also apply to EXP Special Happy Courses!

notes.title: Shot Online Steam Service Closure Compensation and Rewards Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/abcbbd33f17d4edce7a02dd51e19fbb9d1b73a85.jpg[/img]

Dear Shot Online Community,
As we are coming close to service closure of Shot Online on Steam, we have arrived with details regarding rewards and compensations planned to be provided to users who have applied as migrating users to the Shot Online US server.
[b]Only users who have at least one character above LV100 on Shot Online Steam is eligible to apply for the Supporting Boxes and 30 Day Deluxe Membership![/b]

[h1][b]Accounts and characters made from July 17th are not eligible to apply for the Supporting Boxes.[/b][/h1]

Users who have reached Lv100 or above on Shot Online Steam and have registered a new UID within the US server can receive the following supporting boxes. All items within the supporting boxes are untradeable. 
Please send us your Shot Online Steam UID and character name, along with your newly registered US server UID through our in-game reporting system. We will check the registration date for the US server UID and once we are done with reviewing the information, we will send out the boxes to your new US account. [b]Please be aware that according to US policy, only two UIDs can be owned by one user at once.[/b]
We will be providing you with a total of 4 boxes. The Lv 1 Global Server Transfer Box can be open upon receiving it.

[u][b]**Caution: [/b][/u]
Once all boxes are distributed, your steam account will be locked.
The migration will take max. 2 business days (within 48hrs). Migration will not happen during weekends. 
The players who have wrote their US server UID wrong will not be reworked.
The migration registration will be opened until the server closes on Nov. 6th.

[olist]
[*] Components for the Lv 1 Global Server Transfer Box are as follows:
[table]

         [th][b]Composition[/b][/th]

     [/tr]
     [tr]

     [/tr]
     [tr]

     [/tr]
     [tr]

     [tr]

     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]5000000NG[/td]
     [/tr]

[table]

         [th][b]Composition[/b][/th]
     [/tr]

[/table] 

[*] Once you reach Lv 104 and achieve Royal Pro, you will be able to open the Lv 104 Royal Pro Achievement Box. The components are as follows:

     [/tr]

[*] Once you reach Lv 120 and achieve National Pro, you will be able to open the Lv 120 National Pro Achievement Box. The components are as follows:

notes.title: Shot Online #4 Patch Note (2019.06.26)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9f0dc9d39376a093aab3af91891a3d77d805f850.jpg[/img]


Hello Everyone!
Below are the details that have been updated through June Maintenance.



[h1][b]1. New Audhumbla Clubs[/b][/h1]
We have arrived with a new full set of clubs: Audhumbla. Check out the new design of the clubs and enjoy them in-game shortly!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9f5fc1a9eadf75900429485091c204c8117cbd30.jpg[/img]



[h1][b]2. New Summer Clothes[/b][/h1]
New Summer Seasonal Clothes and a Special Contest Winning Set of Clothes have been added to the game! You will be able to enjoy the game with the seasonal Baseball themed clothes and Hot Summer Vibe themed special clothes shortly!

<Baseball Collection>
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/31fcddef483566a59aea396fb506b54be2773599.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/7688e0c22bb9b5811e13c37fc6477dbcc041fa27.jpg[/img]

<Summer Vibe Collection>
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9026c7eb1f0ccca6918f22af33f41eaa322a0675.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/758b60f686bca4d928e55de2ca67df871dd30654.png[/img]



[h1][b]3. Additional Contents[/b][/h1]

[b]1) Dino Park Course added to Guild Agency[/b]
Guilds can now select Dino Park Course from the Guild Agency!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/b2510c65cd86d61bf05c588d5d09b24f8e57263f.jpg[/img]


[b]2) Missions and Holecount Events[/b]
Playing in World Travel Mode and Miniature Mode will also apply as participating in Mission events and Holecount events from now on.



[h1][b]4. Bugs Fixed[/b][/h1]
[olist]
[*] Honor Pro users can now participate in Channel Tours
[*] New warning text has been added to the Character Name Change Ticket – The Swing Trainer buff will disappear if you use the ticket while having the buff active
[*] Game freezes when participating in Speed Matching with a 0 durability club equipped have been fixed
[*] Game freezes when the player pays the fee to enter the Graduation test have been fixed
[*] Guild Amity hat was not able to be equipped or taken off have been fixed
[*] Players are able to enter Hard Course Practice Mode through Caddies without any game crashes
[*] D~B Rank Guilds can apply for Channel Tours
[*] Client crashing when writing through the Megaphone item and hitting the Enter key twice have been fixed.
[*] Description has been edited for Lucky Boxes earned through Guild House benefits – The boxes will be distributed to the inventory instead of the Guild Locker.
[*] Additional Channel Tours can be opened while other Channel Tours are in progress.
[/olist]

We hope you will enjoy the new features!

Thank you for playing Shot Online Steam.


Best,
Shot Online Team

notes.title: Shot Online Steam June Events
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/631df54ed41687e983703ba5e9326143a30f83d8.jpg[/img]
Hello Everyone!

We have arrived with a detailed announcement regarding our June Events for Shot Online Steam!

[h1][b]1. Nearest Mini Game[/b][/h1]
For June, we will be introducing a new type of Mini game: Nearest. Nearest Mini Game is based on how close your ball approaches to the hole in one shot.

[b]Theme[/b]: Nearest
[b]Daily Join Limit[/b]: 10

[b]Daily Join Reward[/b]: Swing Trainer K-1 [15%]
[b]Top 1~15%[/b]: Bianca’s Lucky Token [2H]
[b]Top 16~50%[/b]: Baxter’s Lucky Token [2H]
[b]Top 51~100%[/b]: Anthony’s Lucky Token [2H]

[b]Time Period: [/b]
Start Date: 2019/06/01 (00:00 UTC)
End Date: 2019/06/23 (23:59 UTC)

[b]~How to Earn Approach Tickets~[/b]
Receive 5 Approach Tickets daily by visiting NPC Ceridwen! You can also craft additional 5 approach tickets through the Item Recipe System!

[b]~After you have obtained Approach Tickets~[/b]
1. Right-Click a "Approach Ticket" in your inventory to add "Possess Approach Count" to your character.
2. Move to the Mini Game NPC in the Square with your character who has "Possess Approach Count"
3. Click the Mini Game feature to enter. 1x "Possess Approach Count" will be deducted.

[b]~Nearest Mini Game Details~[/b]
There are three tabs that will be noticed once joining the Mini Game Event. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/7c23e4c9864a92ad2b953629771deb01051004ca.jpg[/img]
You will be able to see the details regarding each tab by clicking them.

Once you enter the Nearest Mini Game, you will be able to notice that there are 3 courses. Each course has [b]4 holes to play[/b]. You will consume 1x “Possess Approach Count” per course, and you will be able to play all 4 holes per ticket.

After making a valid record, you will be able to notice you record, along with the ranking associated with that record. [b]The “Total Score” shows the overall score after playing all 12 holes.[/b]

[b]~How to Play~[/b]
You will have to land the ball on [b]Green, Green Edge, or Hole Cup[/b] by a single shot.
If the ball fails to reach on either [b]Green, Green Edge, or Hole Cup[/b], then you will not be able to receive a record for that hole.
The record will renew for every better approach. No matter how well you play on certain holes, unless you complete all 12 holes, you will not be able to receive a ranking.

For every hole, you will be able to find the following results display:
[table]
     [tr]
         [th][b]Approach Failed[/b][/th]
         [th][b]Approached[/b][/th]
         [th][b]New Approach Record[/b][/th]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/658a0c9f02d461a2ddda91cbd840d908793fd91e.jpg[/img][/td]
         [td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/c50a668cd2dbb6bb5377d3df07e5d9c5027a8dc9.jpg[/img][/td]
         [td][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/9e9933c9fd3147d262042b2a3799f98b30f9c60c.jpg[/img][/td]
     [/tr]
[/table] 

[h1]Please Note:[/h1]
- Your "Possess Approach Count" will reset at the conclusion of the event, but if you hold Approach tickets as an item, ticket will not be expired.
- Reward items will expire 30 days after receiving the item. 
[b]- Daily Join Reward will be distributed as soon as you join the Mini game event.
- Ranking Rewards will be distributed once you re-connect to the game after the event concludes.[/b]

[h1][b]2. Mission Event[/b][/h1]
Another Mission Event will start on June 1st! For this month’s Mission Event, you will be able to collect “Water Balloons” that are needed to craft “Lucky Box” items through Meriel’s Item Recipe System.
The Mission Event will take place [b]every Weekend starting June 1st until June 30th[/b]. The rewards for the Mission Events are as followed:
[table]
     [tr]
         [th]Course[/th]
         [th]Requirement[/th]
         [th]Reward[/th]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]All Easy (Except CT Park Public)[/td]
         [td]Complete 18 holes with a score of 65 or better[/td]
         [td]1x Water Balloon[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]All Normal[/td]
         [td]Complete 18 holes with a score of 67 or better[/td]
         [td]2x Water Balloon[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]All Hard[/td]
         [td]Complete 18 holes with a score of 69 or better[/td]
         [td]3x Water Balloon[/td]
     [/tr]
[/table] 

With the  Water Balloon items, you can craft Event Cards, that are used for crafting Lucky Boxes!
[b]4 Water Balloon Items are required to craft 1 Event Card.[/b]

You will be able to craft the following Lucky Box Items with the Event Cards!
[table]
     [tr]
         [th]Box Item[/th]
         [th]Composition[/th]
         [th]Amount[/th]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Lucky Box I[/td]
         [td]Hesione Gem 50, Epimetheus Gem 50, Pandora Gem 50, Brooch [5%/5%], Mageia Plus N2 50, Mageia Plus N2.5 18, Mageia Plus N3 50, Theurgia P20 50, Theurgia P25 50, Theurgia P30 50, Bronze Tee, Silver Tee, Ambrosia 5%, Ambrosia 10%, Ambrosia 15%, Ambrosia 20%, Ambrosia 25%, Pandora Ball 4PC [15%], Prometheus Ball 4PC [20%], Atlas Ball 4PC [25%], Swing Trainer K-2 [15%], Swing Trainer K-2 [20%][/td]
         [td]2x Event Cards[/td]
     [/tr]
     [tr]
         [td]Lucky Box II[/td]
         [td]Prometheus Gem 50, Odin I Brooch [10%/10%], Mageia Plus N3.5 50, Mageia Plus N4 50, Theurgia P35 50, Theurgia P40 50, Theurgia P45 50, Gold Tee, Ambrosia 30%, Ambrosia 35%, Ambrosia 40%, Ambrosia 45%, Swing Trainer K-2 [25%], Clymene Ball 4PC [30%], Metis Ball 4PC [35%][/td]
         [td]4x Event Cards[/td]
     [/tr]
[/table] 

[b]The reward will be a random item from one of the composition items per box.[/b]

[h1][b]NOTE:[/b][/h1]
All leftover Water Balloon items and Event Cards after the conclusion of the event will be collected during maintenance.
You can craft as much Lucky Boxes as you want, as long as you have the enough amount of tickets!

We hope you will enjoy our June events!

Best,
Shot Online Team

notes.title: Official Announcement regarding Shot Online Steam
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33277556/abcbbd33f17d4edce7a02dd51e19fbb9d1b73a85.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone!

We have arrived with an announcement regarding the current Shot Online Steam. We apologize for not being able to communicate with players openly during the past days, and would like to share with everyone in the Shot Online Steam community with our current situation.

[olist]
[*]More game contents
[list]
[*]We have been trying our best to pass on the feedback that we have been receiving from the players. However, the developers of the game are having a hard time to implement the game features that are already provided from our other branches to Steam as they must change all contents to match the Steam platform. This requires more time than expected, thus causing delay to content updates.
[*]We fully understand that this frustrates all players on Shot Online Steam, and we are frustrated as well regarding this issue, as we cannot provide the contents that the players wish the most.
[*]We are currently working on a fixed plan for future updates for Shot Online Steam, and trying our best to fit in every suggestion and feedback from users to be part of the update plan.
[/list]
[*]Sales and Items
[list]
[*]We understand that Shot Online Steam lacks many items compared to our other branches. However, the reason that we are slowing down on releasing more items is to match with the update process of the game contents.
[*]Since we could not get a clear answer from the developers as to when we will get content updates, we are hesitant on releasing more items at this point.
[*]We will be taking notes of the items that players wish to be updated as priority along with content updates, so please list out the items that you wish the most beneath this post as comments and we will pass it on to the developers.
[/list]
[*]Service
[list]
[*]Most feedback that we have been receiving from players is that Shot Online Steam lacks players and there are hardly anyone on server. We understand that this is due to lack of contents, thus players are losing interest on continuing with playing the game.
[*]We want to inform you that this does not mean that we have left the game from our hands. We are working hard to make up for the blank space that needs to be covered with more contents, in order to keep players occupied with playing contents through events.
[/list]
[/olist]

We are sorry that we could not keep up with your anticipation towards this game. We understand the disappointment and frustrations that the players have on our game at the moment. We have been delaying our official response towards this game as we were also unsure of the exact date for updates. 

[h1][b]Official announcements regarding new content updates is going to be posted as soon as we get a fixed date from the developers.[/b][/h1]

Thank you very much for your patience towards our game, and we apologize once again.


Best,
Shot Online Team

notes.title: Shot Online #1 Patch Note (2019.01.31)
notes.content:

Hello Everyone! 

Around a week has passed since our grand launch on Steam! Through the in-game report system and the discussion board, we have collected feedback from players about the game, and arrived with a brief but crucial update.

[b]1. Server Time Change[/b]
Starting tomorrow, we will be changing the server time from PST to UTC. We will be hosting events and giving out rewards according to the standard UTC time, so don’t get confused with the changed standard server time!
**You will be able to check the server time by typing /time on the chat window in-game.

[h1][IMPORTANT][/h1]
For players who have bought the Gold Platinum Membership since the launching date, the membership duration already applied in UTC standard time. Since the Membership system was applied as UTC standard time, we have decided to change the server time to UTC as well. 

[b]2. Bugs fixed[/b]
Throughout the past week we have been receiving several reports and notices regarding incorrect or missing descriptions for quests and items. After reviewing the reported cases, we have fixed the errors. 

[b]3. New Items in the Item Recipe System[/b]
To encourage more players to use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1627013511]Item Recipe System[/url], we have added a new item: Zodiac Pin I 100. By using the Zodiac Pin I 100, players will get a boost of +1 for all stats for the next 100 holes played. This can be crafted by using ‘A fabric Piece’ you get during the rounding.

[b]4. New Caddie Package in the Item Mall[/b]
We have added a new sales item to the Item Mall: Caddie Package. You will be able to hire Caddies through purchasing the Caddie Package. For more details regarding the caddie system, please see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1640460579]Caddie Guide[/url].

We hope you will enjoy the new features!

Best,
Shot Online Team

[*][b]Guild Event[/b]
[list]
[*]Guild is the key component of the Shot Online Community. If you create or join a Guild, there will be rewards!
[/list]
[h1]NOTE: Reward distribution date is yet to be announced.
[/h1]

[*][b]Level-up Box Event[/b]
[list]
[*]From level 5 to 50, you will be given Level-up boxes that contains various items, such as EXP items, equipment, clothing etc.
[/list]
[h1]NOTE: There will be a total of 7 Level up boxes, which will be given each at Lv 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 45, and 50.
[/h1]

[*][b]Community Hub Event[/b]
[list]
[*]Rewards will be given if you upload gameplay related contents on the community hub. Contents may include screenshots and videos.
[/list]
[h1]NOTE: Screenshots and videos must contain your character ID clearly.
[/h1]

[*][b]20% Bonus CC Event[/b]
[list]
[*]For players who start playing Shot Online from the launching date; you will be rewarded 20% Bonus CC with the regular charge amount for a month.
Go to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/390090/announcements/detail/1718587807639794150]CC Event page[/url] for more details regarding this event.
[/list]
[/olist]
We hope you will enjoy the game along with these events!
